item.text:
The reference appears to have a round-section eye, a circular collar, and a plain cylindrical shank. I’ll place the eye in the YZ plane to match its tilt across the four views.

[Open the CAD model](http://127.0.0.1:8772/#part.FCStd)
The preview matches the eye’s orientation. I’ll lower it into the collar and refine the raised center seat to match the visible junction in the reference.
